criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Acceptance
categories.definition: Queries related to where and if the card is accepted by businesses or ATMs.

categories.name: Account Access
categories.definition: Issues related to accessing or using the account, such as transfers, top-ups, and balance updates.

categories.name: Card Delivery
categories.definition: Questions about the delivery process of physical or virtual cards.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Queries regarding exchanging currencies or cross-currency transactions.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Concerns about fees, charges, or unexpected costs associated with transactions.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Issues related to verifying identity for security or transaction purposes.

categories.name: Disputes and Refunds
categories.definition: Queries about disputing transactions, refunds, or unauthorized payments.

categories.name: Card Security
categories.definition: Concerns about card security, including lost or stolen cards, PIN issues, or unauthorized transactions.

categories.name: Card Functionality
categories.definition: Questions about card functionality, such as activation, top-up options, or contactless payments.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Issues related to transferring money, delays in transfers, or failed transfer attempts.
